title: Enforce performance budgets in script + CI
decision: Performance budgets are codified in scripts/perf-budget.mjs and enforced with a non-zero exit mode consumed by npm scripts and CI checks.
context: Migration introduced measurable payload improvements that must be preserved over time.
implementation: scripts/perf-budget.mjs compares build artifacts against baseline and thresholds.
ci:check includes perf:budget:enforce as a release gate.
consequences: Repeatable audit trail for old-vs-new metric drift.
